about.title: About AgroAdvisor-ET
about.lead: An evidence-grounded advisor that ranks agroecological practices for a specific place in Ethiopia and shows the field studies behind every recommendation.

what.title: What it is
what.body: AgroAdvisor-ET reads the agro-ecological context under a map pin — rainfall, temperature, altitude, slope, soil and growing period from a 250 m geospatial stack — and ranks practices with a model trained on thousands of paired with/without field observations from Ethiopian trials. The retrieval layer then explains each recommendation with passages from the very studies the model learned from.

confidence.title: How to read confidence
confidence.body: This is a ranking tool, not a yield forecaster. Honest cross-validated skill is modest, so trust the order of practices more than the exact percentages.
confidence.high: well supported by field trials in settings like yours
confidence.medium: reasonable evidence; treat the order as the signal
confidence.low: thin evidence — a starting point, not a forecast. The advisor says so instead of bluffing.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.evidence: Evidence for Resilient Agriculture (ERA) — Ethiopia subset of paired field observations, with the Adimassu et al. climate-smart agriculture studies.
sources.geo: WorldClim climate, SoilGrids soil, Copernicus elevation and slope, ESA WorldCover land cover, FAO growing-period data, and the Ethiopian agro-ecological belts.
sources.guidance: GARDIAN / CGSpace implementation guidance (CGIAR knowledge products) for the how-to layer.
sources.practice: WOCAT Global SLM Database practice records (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), for cross-country context in a later release.
